requirements.name: Customer profile lifecycle management
requirements.summary: The system must enable the creation, modification, and archival of customer identity and preference records throughout their engagement.

requirements.name: Store partner agreement versioning
requirements.summary: The system must support the creation, amendment, and historical tracking of commercial terms between the platform and store partners.

requirements.name: Product catalog change management
requirements.summary: The system must allow the structured creation, update, and archival of product descriptions, pricing, and availability data.

requirements.name: Delivery zone boundary updates
requirements.summary: The system must facilitate the creation, modification, and versioning of geospatial service area definitions and travel time matrices.

requirements.name: Dispute ticket status tracking
requirements.summary: The system must manage the creation, state transitions, and archival of records for unresolved issues like missing or damaged goods.

requirements.name: Financial transaction record archiving
requirements.summary: The system must enable the secure creation, retention, and long-term archival of detailed financial ledgers and settlement records.

requirements.name: Service area definition lifecycle
requirements.summary: The system must handle the creation, activation, deactivation, and historical tracking of geographically delimited delivery zones.

requirements.name: Delivery assignment status history
requirements.summary: The system must record the complete lifecycle of delivery assignments, including creation, allocation changes, and final closure states.
